questions.question: Calculate the percentage of superheroes with blue eyes.
questions.evidence: percentage = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(fld008 WHERE color = 'Blue'), COUNT(fld008)), 100.0); blue eyes refers to color = 'Blue' and color.fld001 =  fld011 = 7;
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.fld004 = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld011 = T2.fld001
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id

questions.question: Provide the heights of the heroes whose eye colours are amber.
questions.evidence: heights of the heroes refers to fld017; eye colours are amber refers to fld004.fld004 = 'Amber' WHERE fld011 = fld004.fld001;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld017 FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld011 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld004 = 'Amber'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.height_cm FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber'

questions.question: Identify superheroes who can control wind and list their names in alphabetical order.
questions.evidence: superheroes refers to fld008; can control wind refers to fld022 = 'Wind Control';
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld008 FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab10 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld019 INNER JOIN tab09 AS T3 ON T2.fld023 = T3.fld001 WHERE T3.fld022 = 'Wind Control' ORDER BY T1.fld008
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Wind Control' ORDER BY T1.superhero_name

questions.question: What is the percentage of blue female superheroes among all female superheroes?
questions.evidence: percentage = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(fld004 = 'Blue' WHERE fld005 = 'Female'), COUNT(fld005 = 'Female')), 100); blue refers to the color = 'Blue' WHERE fld013 = fld004.fld001; female refers to fld005 = 'Female';
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.fld004 = 'Blue' THEN T1.fld001 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld010 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T3 ON T1.fld013 = T3.fld001 WHERE T2.fld005 = 'Female'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.colour = 'Blue' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.gender = 'Female'

questions.question: Identify the gender of the superhero who has the ability of Phoenix Force.
questions.evidence: ability of Phoenix Force refers to fld022 = 'Phoenix Force';
questions.SQL: SELECT T4.fld005 FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab10 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld019 INNER JOIN tab09 AS T3 ON T2.fld023 = T3.fld001 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T4 ON T1.fld010 = T4.fld001 WHERE T3.fld022 = 'Phoenix Force'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T4.gender FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id INNER JOIN gender AS T4 ON T1.gender_id = T4.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Phoenix Force'

questions.question: What is the percentage of superheroes who act in their own self-interest or make decisions based on their own moral code? Indicate how many of the said superheroes were published by Marvel Comics.
questions.evidence: published by Marvel Comics refers to fld006 = 'Marvel Comics'; superheroes who act in their own self-interest or make decisions based on their own moral code refers to fld002 = 'Bad'; calculation = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(fld002 = 'Bad); count(fld001)), 100)
questions.SQL: SELECT (CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab07)), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld006 = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld015 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T3 ON T3.fld001 = T1.fld016 WHERE T3.fld002 = 'Bad'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT (CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero)), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN alignment AS T3 ON T3.id = T1.alignment_id WHERE T3.alignment = 'Bad'

questions.question: How many percent of female heroes were published by Marvel Comics?
questions.evidence: percent = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(fld005 = 'Female' WHERE fld006 = 'Marvel Comics'), COUNT(fld006 = 'Marvel Comics')), 100); female heroes refers to fld005 = 'Female'; Marvel Comics refers to fld006 = 'Marvel Comics';
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.fld005 = 'Female' AND T2.fld006 = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.fld006 = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100 FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld015 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T3 ON T1.fld010 = T3.fld001
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.gender = 'Female' AND T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100 FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id

questions.question: What is Abomination's superpower?
questions.evidence: Abomination refers to fld008 = 'Abomination'; superpower refers to fld022;
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.fld022 FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab10 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld019 INNER JOIN tab09 AS T3 ON T2.fld023 = T3.fld001 WHERE T1.fld008 = 'Abomination'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
